text_block_list.text:
After our outing, Daiwa Scarlet and I
returned to the academy, but—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Just a little more!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Would you like to go hang out somewhere else—just for a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
S-See! You've been having a tough time lately, Trainer,
so shouldn't you take a little more rest?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's right, overworking is no good!
You have to build up your energy properly! Yep!
choice_data_list: The sun is already going down, are you sure about this...?
The sun is already going down, are you sure about this...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's————fine.
It's no big deal.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, you're my Trainer, aren't you?
If you're exhausted—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: It's not so much that it troubles me, but... well—
choice_data_list: ...How about we go grab something delicious to eat!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah! Yeah! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah—*ahem*!
W-Well, it seems like it'd be good for your rest too, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll accompany you.
However—I won't tolerate any halfhearted efforts, understood?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If you're dragging a model student like me around,
you'd better make sure I have a blast!

...After that, I was able to enjoy a fun meal
with a smiling Daiwa Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Kh, o-of course I do!
I just told you! It'd cause trouble for me too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So, um... I was kind of hoping
I could let my hair down a bit more, but...
choice_data_list: Well then, shall we have some tea in the Trainer's Room?
Well, shall we have some tea in the Trainer's office?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
H-Hmph!
Th-That wouldn't change anything from how it usually is!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Well, but still, that's not a bad idea.
It makes it easier to make all sorts of excuses, just in case. Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that that's settled, let's get moving!
You'd better serve some good tea snacks today, at least!
Afterward, we had some tea in the trainer's office, relaxing and chatting about trivial things.
